authority.q_design_02: BLOCKED - transcript-dependent Stage motion/integration still lacks E0-A vs E0-E behavioral evidence

question: Can listening, performed Character silence and technical/system non-response remain visually and semantically distinct without transcript-first UI, timing inference, motive inference or fictionalizing infrastructure?
accepted_grammar: Listening is a visible current Stage state and means presence without current speaking; it is not absence, performed silence, refusal, emotion, agreement, passivity or technical failure.
Performed silence is valid Character-legible performance/agency and must be explicitly distinguishable from missing output or system failure.

Technical non-response remains application/infrastructure state outside fiction and cannot create or overwrite Character silence, refusal, indecision, dramatic tension, causal history or accepted Production change.
The surrounding Stage state may remain unchanged while application truth is presented outside the Character carrier.
The final product need not be transcript-first or message-centric merely because speech, silence and non-response must be distinguishable.
The distinction must survive narrow layout and forced-colors presentation without depending on motion, color alone or portraits.

recursive_audit.defect_repaired: The first comparison also changed Marlowe from Speaking to Listening in the performed-silence specimen, weakening causal isolation of Wren's state.
recursive_audit.correction: All three specimens now hold the surrounding Stage state constant: Marlowe remains Speaking, Iona remains Current Opportunity, and only Wren changes between Listening and performed Silence; the technical non-response specimen leaves the fictional Stage state unchanged.

explicit_non_authority: No duration, pause, silence threshold, timing, turn-taking or cadence semantics are frozen.
No intent, motive, emotion, refusal, relationship meaning or psychological inference is derived from listening or silence.
No provider timeout, retry, fallback, cancellation, recovery algorithm, error taxonomy or accepted-failure behavior is established.
No transcript/provenance placement, Stage motion, cone-carrier redesign, final palette/type/iconography or native WinUI behavior is created.
Q-DESIGN-02 remains blocked; this static study does not consume transcript-dependent Stage motion authority.
conclusion: PASS: listening, performed Character silence and technical non-response remain distinct static meanings without transcript-first UI or fictionalized infrastructure.
next_boundary: Run the consolidated Phase-2 static-coverage closeout audit against the three-phase program, Phase-2 entry gate, Stage authority and all six completed bounded studies; fresh-reconcile Engineering before any disposition toward Phase 3 or blocked transcript-dependent work.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
